title: The Fox and the Geese
summary: A cunning fox crept into a green meadow where a flock of plump, healthy geese were peacefully grazing. Licking his chops, the fox stepped into their midst and said, "I have arrived...
full_text:
A cunning fox crept into a green meadow where a flock of plump, healthy geese were peacefully grazing. Licking his chops, the fox stepped into their midst and said, "I have arrived at the perfect hour; you are all fat and tender, and I intend to devour every single one of you on the spot!"

The terrified geese cackled and fluttered their wings in panic. One brave goose, keeping her wits about her, stepped forward and said: "Noble Fox, we know we must perish, but grant us one small, reasonable favor before we die. Allow us to say one final prayer so that we may depart this world in peace, and afterward we will line up in an orderly row so you may eat the fattest first."

"Very well," agreed the fox smugly. "That is a pious request. Pray on, and I will wait."

The first goose began her prayer: "Ga! Ga! Ga!"

The second goose took up the chant: "Ga! Ga! Ga!"

The third and fourth joined in, and soon the entire flock was honking and cackling "Ga! Ga! Ga!" at the top of their lungs, never ceasing for a single second.

The fox sat patiently waiting for the prayer to finish, but the geese are still praying to this very hour, and until they stop, the fox must sit and listen, unable to taste a single bite!
moral: Quick thinking in the face of peril can buy time and foil the cruelest schemes.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Fox and the Geese"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.

vocabulary.meaning: wise advice given to guide decisions
the ability to judge well and understand the truth
